item.title: 50 Goals
item.description:
Related: 50 Goals (Old Version) Bucket List Mini Essay - Ridiculous Bucket List

Write Mini Essays about each of these

Can Do vs WANT to do

  • #1 See a huge rocket launch
  • #2 Live in a wood cabin by a lake
  • #3 Be a ginger space unicorn
  • #4 Have a cave diving TV show
  • #5 Create music & drawings I’m proud of

Diving

  1. ==Have a Cave Diving TV Show==
    • Focus on conservation & fresh water access
  2. ==Map caves for others to experience in VR==
    • Create an art experience that moves people
  3. ==Organise & Lead Adventure around the world==
    • Soggy Wombat Cave #Expeditions
  4. Dive
    • Bikini Atoll (2027)
    • Bushman’s Hole (2028?)
    • Below 200m
    • 500 hours on a rebreather Writing & Art
  5. ==Publish 10 Books - To Write==
  6. Draw cartoons I’m proud of - Tablet
  7. To sing & play music I’m proud of - Practice Ukulele
  8. Finish the “101 Things” Reading List - 101 Things - To Do Experience
  9. Meditate for an hour without interruption - Practice
  10. Travel
    1. Walk +3000km solo
    2. Walk the Inca Trail
    3. Cross the Sahara
  11. Live
    1. ==In silent retreat at a wood cabin by a lake==
    2. On a boat for a year
    3. Overwinter in Antarctica
  12. See
    1. Leopard Seals - Antarctica
    2. Orcas
    3. ==A huge rocket launch== - BFR
    4. An erupting volcano - Vanuatu (Mt Yasur, Tanna Island)
    5. A baby sloth - Costa Rica
  13. Adventure
    • Jump from an altitude where the sky above is black - 25km/82,000ft or higher
    • Jump with a wingsuit - Requires +200 regular jumps
    • Finish the “101 Things” rollercoaster list - Japan - Steel Dragon
    • Race skeleton - Norway Space
  14. Find & Communicate with Extra-terrestrial life - METI Book
  15. Visit the Moon
  16. Live on Mars
    • Be a scribe
    • Find alien life
  17. Develop/Build something to take humans to another star Ambition
  18. Have more than enough money to spare & share
  19. Help a billion people - School for Moral Ambition
  20. Be/Meet a ginger space unicorn like Tilly
  21. Change the way we see ourselves as a species

References
